quarterly_data.signal: Gates launched the IntraLogix LRB-100 live roller belt for warehouse and distribution-center conveyor systems, a homogeneous polyurethane design replacing conventional fabric construction; it is now available in the United States, with international availability to follow, joining LRB-45 and LRB-77. In Gates' testing against conventional belt designs: more than five times longer belt life, approximately 75% less elongation, roughly 80% greater abrasion resistance, approximately 24% greater weld strength than other belts used on accumulating roller pneumatic (ARP) conveyance systems, and on average 73% lower drive tensions. Gates describes warehouse automation as a growing market for engineered belt solutions.
